name: bld_prod_sin_pi_div_odd
statement: (n : ℕ) : ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (((k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi / (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1)) = Real.sqrt (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1) / 2 ^ n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin (((k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi / (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1)) = Real.sqrt (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1) / 2 ^ n
informal: Uses Mathlib2.geo_prod_sin_pi_mul_div with 2n factors: the reflection k ↦ 2n+1-k pairs the factors (sin(π - t) = sin t), so the square of the half product equals (2n+1)/2^(2n); take the positive square root since every factor is positive.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.sin ((↑k + 1) * Real.pi / (2 * ↑n + 1)) = √(2 * ↑n + 1) / 2 ^ n
